user.title: Connect to Västtrafik
user.description: Get your credentials from [developer.vasttrafik.se](https://developer.vasttrafik.se) → My Applications → create an app → copy the key and secret.

data_description.secret: Stored securely and never shown again
data_description.use_home: Sends Home Assistant's home coordinate to Västtrafik to suggest nearby stops and to plan trips from and to your door. Turn off to keep it private.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Västtrafik
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials were rejected. Enter a valid API key and secret to reconnect.

start_stop.title: Where do you board?
start_stop.description: Pick a stop near your home or type any stop name, e.g. {example}.

data_description.stop_name: You can use city name for precision, e.g. 'Brunnsparken, Göteborg'

end_stop.title: Where are you going? (optional)
end_stop.description:
Adding a destination filters the line list to only lines that go there, and auto-selects the direction. Leave blank to see all lines from **{start}**.

Example: {example}

pick_stop.title: Multiple stops found
pick_stop.description: Your search matched more than one stop. Select the correct one.

pick_line.title: Which line?
pick_line.description: Lines currently departing from **{stop}**. Select the line you want to track.

line_manual.title: Enter the line name
line_manual.description: No live departures found at **{stop}** right now. Enter the line short name (e.g. `16`, `Röd`, `V1`).

pick_direction.title: Which direction?
pick_direction.description: Filter line **{line}** from **{stop}** to a specific end destination, or choose any direction.

line_options.title: All set!
line_options.description:
**Line {line}** from **{stop}** → **{direction}**

Three entities will be created automatically:
- 🕐 **Departure time** — next departure with realtime delay and platform
- ⚠️ **Disruption** — live service disruption alerts
- 📍 **Position** — vehicle location on the map when available

data_description.delay: Show departures at least this many minutes in the future — set this to your walk time.
data_description.name: Prefix used for all related entities. Leave blank to use the auto-generated name.

apis.title: Extra Västtrafik APIs
apis.description: Disruptions, stop details and commuter parking come from separate Västtrafik APIs. Each has to be added to your application at [developer.vasttrafik.se](https://developer.vasttrafik.se) before your key can use it. The boxes below are ticked for the ones your key can use right now; the rest of the integration works without them.

data_description.use_geografi: Tariff zones, Närtrafik and parking facilities.
data_description.use_parking: Free spaces, forecasts and cameras for parkings at the stops you board at.

error.auth: Authentication failed — check your API key and secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Västtrafik API. Check your connection.
error.station_not_found: No stop found. Try adding the city, e.g. 'Brunnsparken, Göteborg'.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred — check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.line_exists: That line is already monitored from this stop in this direction.
error.api_not_enabled: Your API key has no access to one of the ticked APIs. Add it to your application at developer.vasttrafik.se first, or untick it.

abort.already_configured: This Västtrafik account is already configured. Use the options button to add more lines.

search_journey.description: Finds the next journeys between two stops and returns them.

config_entry_id.description: Västtrafik entry to use when more than one is set up.

time.name: Time
time.description: Departure time, or arrival time with Arrive by. Defaults to now.

arrive_by.name: Arrive by
arrive_by.description: Treat the time as the latest arrival.

only_direct.name: Direct only
only_direct.description: Leave out journeys with a change.

transport_modes.name: Transport modes
transport_modes.description: Restrict the search to these modes.
